$comment: Single source of truth for the quantitative grammar. See docs/design/quantitative-grammar.md. viz/grammar.ts DERIVES its typed constants from this file and audit_quantitative.mjs enforces it, so the TS and the gate can never drift. Do not hand-duplicate these values anywhere.
$rungOrderNote: Ordered weakest to strongest by WARRANT TO WRITE. `downgraded` sits below `held` deliberately: a proof that drift withdrew is a proof that did not hold, so it warrants more scrutiny than a cell merely awaiting review, and under never-overstate the lower rank is the safe direction. `idle` is rank 0 and is never drawn -- only flagged cells emit marks.

salienceWeights.$comment: Weights for the MEASURED salience used to assert ladder monotonicity. fill/stroke are fractions of a mark covered in ink; contact and glow are the earned-salience channels. Total must be strictly increasing in rung strength.

$addressableNote: A mark may carry a rung ONLY if it represents exactly one claim and is at least this tall (L2, the addressability law). The previous design used depthLegibleMinPx=8 to suppress depth on tiny aggregated marks, which made depth unreachable on every real dataset: 1000 rows into a 420px surface gives 3.0px marks. Suppression was the wrong fix; the right one is not to put rungs on aggregates at all.

aggregation.$comment: There is no rung-aggregation rule, deliberately. Aggregated marks carry no rung at all (L2), so there is nothing to aggregate. Minimum-rung and maximum-rung were both tried and both rejected; see quantitative-grammar.md section 3.2.

evidence-overview.purpose: Neutral density map of where cells are flagged. Carries NO rung: marks are aggregated row-bands and are not individually addressable.

claim-detail.purpose: Individually addressable claims: one DOM object per claim, carrying rung by hue, form, text and earned depth.

dependency-graph.purpose: Functional-dependency edges between columns, deterministic layered layout.

confidence-distribution.purpose: Per-issue-type detector confidence histogram. States that confidence is near-degenerate and is not a ranking signal; draws NO threshold line, because _DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS gates the corrector path, not deterministic auto-apply.

$notBuilt.calibration-plot: NOT REGISTERED because it is not buildable here, and a registry entry for a component that does not exist is exactly the vacuity this gate exists to catch. No calibration, conformal, reliability or ECE data appears anywhere in the playground API response: those artifacts come from a calibration session over labelled samples, not from a single stateless analyse call. Plotting the committed eval artifact instead would present one dataset's measurement as if it described the user's run. Recorded as an open unknown in docs/design/quantitative-grammar.md rather than fabricated.
